description: Meal & Grocery Banger — data structures stored in localStorage and synced to JSONBin.

localStorage_keys.mg_ak: Anthropic API key (string) — used client-side to auto-fill recipes from pasted text
localStorage_keys.mg_trip: Current trip state (Trip object) — device-local only, not synced
localStorage_keys.mg_lastmeals: Snapshot of the recipes selected on the last completed trip (array of {id, name}) — device-local only, not synced
localStorage_keys.mg_lastlist: Snapshot of the full line-item list (with checked state) from the last completed trip, so it stays viewable after starting a new one — device-local only, not synced

id.description: Unix timestamp (Date.now()) used as unique ID

unit.description: e.g. 'cup', 'tbsp', 'oz', 'lb', 'clove'. Empty string means unitless (e.g. '3 eggs').

CheckItem.description: An occasional item — not bought every trip. Reviewed each trip; only added to the list if marked 'out of it'.

LastMealsEntry.description: One entry in the mg_lastmeals snapshot — captured when 'Start New Trip' is pressed, from the trip being closed out.

id.description: Recipe ID at time of capture

name.description: Recipe name at time of capture, kept even if the recipe is later renamed or deleted

Trip.description: Active shopping trip — device-local, not synced to cloud.

selected.description: Recipe IDs chosen for this trip

checksOut.description: CheckItem IDs marked 'out of it' for this trip

active.description: True once the list has been generated

list.description: Flat line items — NOT deduplicated by name. The same ingredient from two different recipes (or from both a staple and a recipe) appears as separate rows, sorted so same-name items sit next to each other.

origin.description: Where this line item came from — 'manual' is a mid-trip quick-add

recipeName.description: Present when origin is 'recipe' — shown as a badge on the row

tag.description: Display text: staple's qty, recipe ingredient's amount+unit, or empty for check items

cloud_sync.notes: Pull on load, push (debounced) on every change. Trip state is NOT synced — it's a device-local shopping session.
